understanding.core_idea: Paging trades external fragmentation for internal fragmentation, wasting on average half a page per process.

teaching_sequence.purpose: Name what paging introduces in place of external fragmentation
teaching_sequence.explanation_goal: Learner understands the waste sits inside the final page

teaching_sequence.concept: Average waste of half a page
teaching_sequence.purpose: Quantify the cost so the trade-off is judgeable
teaching_sequence.explanation_goal: Learner understands why very large pages are not automatically better

source_evidence: The average waste is half a page per process, which is why very large page sizes are not automatically better.
